article.title: Understanding XML for Data Processing
article.summary: XML (eXtensible Markup Language) is a flexible way to structure and transport data. This sample document demonstrates the basic elements commonly found in structured content.

section.heading: Introduction
section.paragraph: XML allows developers and systems to store information in a readable format that is both human‑friendly and machine‑processable.

section.heading: Why XML?
section.paragraph: XML is platform‑independent, widely supported, and ideal for scenarios where structured data interchange is required.

section.heading: Conclusion
section.paragraph: As a versatile markup language, XML continues to play an important role in data pipelines, configuration files, and enterprise systems.
